title: Garden agent monitoring
description: Everyday Garden agent API operations, model calls, tokens, and response outcomes.

panels.title: Agent API operations over time
panels.description: Garden API requests identified as agent calls.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x, COUNT(*) AS y, "http.route" AS series FROM "default" WHERE "garden.agent.flag" = true GROUP BY x, "http.route" ORDER BY x ASC

panels.title: Agent API requests
panels.description: Total API requests made with an Agent login in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS y FROM "default" WHERE "garden.agent.flag" = true

panels.title: Agent operations by route
panels.description: Counts and response status for Garden API operations called by agents.

queries.query: SELECT "http.route" AS x, COUNT(*) AS y, CAST("http.response.status_code" AS VARCHAR) AS series FROM "default" WHERE "garden.agent.flag" = true GROUP BY "http.route", "http.response.status_code" ORDER BY x ASC

panels.title: Model calls and tokens
panels.description: Garden model gateway calls and reported token usage by model.

queries.query: SELECT "gen_ai.request.model" AS x, COUNT(*) AS y, 'Model calls' AS series FROM "default" WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat' GROUP BY "gen_ai.request.model" UNION ALL SELECT "gen_ai.request.model" AS x, SUM("garden.model.usage.total_tokens") AS y, 'Tokens' AS series FROM "default" WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat' GROUP BY "gen_ai.request.model" ORDER BY x ASC, series ASC

panels.title: Recent agent operations
panels.description: Recent agent API operations, response codes, and trace identifiers.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, "http.request.method", "http.route", "http.response.status_code", "garden.person.id", trace_id, duration FROM "default" WHERE "garden.agent.flag" = true ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
